instruction.name: xvstx
instruction.description: Write whole vector data in `data` to memory address `addr + offset`. Address misalignment does not raise an exception.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: xvstx $xr0, $r20, $r4; xvstx $xr1, $r20, $r5; xvstx $xr2, $r20, $r6; xvstx $xr3, $r20, $r7; xvstx $xr4, $r20, $r8; xvstx $xr5, $r20, $r9; xvstx $xr6, $r20, $r10; xvstx $xr7, $r20, $r11
throughput.init: li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr0, $r4; li.d $r4, 2; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr1, $r4; li.d $r4, 3; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr2, $r4; li.d $r4, 4; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr3, $r4; li.d $r4, 5; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr4, $r4; li.d $r4, 6; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr5, $r4; li.d $r4, 7; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr6, $r4; li.d $r4, 8; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr7, $r4; addi.d $r20, $sp, -1024; li.d $r4, 0; li.d $r5, 32; li.d $r6, 64; li.d $r7, 96; li.d $r8, 128; li.d $r9, 160; li.d $r10, 192; li.d $r11, 224
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 7 --init 'li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr0, $r4; li.d $r4, 2; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr1, $r4; li.d $r4, 3; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr2, $r4; li.d $r4, 4; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr3, $r4; li.d $r4, 5; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr4, $r4; li.d $r4, 6; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr5, $r4; li.d $r4, 7; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr6, $r4; li.d $r4, 8; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr7, $r4; addi.d $r20, $sp, -1024; li.d $r4, 0; li.d $r5, 32; li.d $r6, 64; li.d $r7, 96; li.d $r8, 128; li.d $r9, 160; li.d $r10, 192; li.d $r11, 224' --asm 'xvstx $xr0, $r20, $r4; xvstx $xr1, $r20, $r5; xvstx $xr2, $r20, $r6; xvstx $xr3, $r20, $r7; xvstx $xr4, $r20, $r8; xvstx $xr5, $r20, $r9; xvstx $xr6, $r20, $r10; xvstx $xr7, $r20, $r11'

notes: Vector memory operation. Throughput measured with a hot 1KB stack buffer; latency not measured because it depends on cache/coherence state and needs a separate dependency chain.
